units.rawText: <size=40>BOOM!!!!</size>
units.displayText: BOOM!!!!

spans.text: BOOM!!!!

units.rawText: There is another explosion and Centaureissi stops.
units.displayText: There is another explosion and Centaureissi stops.

spans.text: There is another explosion and Centaureissi stops.

units.rawText: Centaureissi!
units.displayText: Centaureissi!

spans.text: Centaureissi!

units.rawText: Urgh...
units.displayText: Urgh...

spans.text: Urgh...

units.rawText: Hel, what's wrong?
units.displayText: Hel, what's wrong?

spans.text: Hel, what's wrong?

units.rawText: Master... I'm detecting multiple hardware failures... I can't keep functioning...
units.displayText: Master... I'm detecting multiple hardware failures... I can't keep functioning...

spans.text: Master... I'm detecting multiple hardware failures... I can't keep functioning...

units.rawText: Is this... click-click-click... what death... feels like?
units.displayText: Is this... click-click-click... what death... feels like?

spans.text: Is this... click-click-click... what death... feels like?

units.rawText: No, no you won't. You won't die! You can't die!
units.displayText: No, no you won't. You won't die! You can't die!

spans.text: No, no you won't. You won't die! You can't die!

units.rawText: Let me out, Centaureissi!
units.displayText: Let me out, Centaureissi!

spans.text: Let me out, Centaureissi!

units.rawText: Hang on... I'm undoing the lock... It's been... twisted.
units.displayText: Hang on... I'm undoing the lock... It's been... twisted.

spans.text: Hang on... I'm undoing the lock... It's been... twisted.

units.rawText: Listen to me, Clotho.
units.displayText: Listen to me, Clotho.

spans.text: Listen to me, Clotho.

units.rawText: I was so worried about you in those days. Luckily, you have Miss Centaureissi with you now. I will be so happy to see you get out of this.
units.displayText: I was so worried about you in those days. Luckily, you have Miss Centaureissi with you now. I will be so happy to see you get out of this.

spans.text: I was so worried about you in those days. Luckily, you have Miss Centaureissi with you now. I will be so happy to see you get out of this.

units.rawText: It's regrettable, but I thought I'd be with you until the very end...
units.displayText: It's regrettable, but I thought I'd be with you until the very end...

spans.text: It's regrettable, but I thought I'd be with you until the very end...

units.rawText: Hel? Hel!
units.displayText: Hel? Hel!

spans.text: Hel? Hel!

units.rawText: The lock finally comes loose and Clotho bursts out.
units.displayText: The lock finally comes loose and Clotho bursts out.

spans.text: The lock finally comes loose and Clotho bursts out.

units.rawText: This is when she sees the Doll and the coffin before her.
units.displayText: This is when she sees the Doll and the coffin before her.

spans.text: This is when she sees the Doll and the coffin before her.

units.rawText: This place is at the limit of the cannons' range, and the shellfire gradually shifts elsewhere.
units.displayText: This place is at the limit of the cannons' range, and the shellfire gradually shifts elsewhere.

spans.text: This place is at the limit of the cannons' range, and the shellfire gradually shifts elsewhere.

units.rawText: Hel looks like a crushed tin can. One can hardly tell she used to be a coffin.
units.displayText: Hel looks like a crushed tin can. One can hardly tell she used to be a coffin.

spans.text: Hel looks like a crushed tin can. One can hardly tell she used to be a coffin.

units.rawText: Centaureissi is also barely recognizable.
units.displayText: Centaureissi is also barely recognizable.

spans.text: Centaureissi is also barely recognizable.

units.rawText: Unable to sustain personality program... Reverting to base settings.
units.displayText: Unable to sustain personality program... Reverting to base settings.

spans.text: Unable to sustain personality program... Reverting to base settings.

units.rawText: Structural damage has exceeded thresholds. Abandoning this unit and withdrawing from the current area is recommended.
units.displayText: Structural damage has exceeded thresholds. Abandoning this unit and withdrawing from the current area is recommended.

spans.text: Structural damage has exceeded thresholds. Abandoning this unit and withdrawing from the current area is recommended.

units.rawText: Hel... Centaureissi...
units.displayText: Hel... Centaureissi...

spans.text: Hel... Centaureissi...

units.rawText: ...Clotho.
units.displayText: ...Clotho.

spans.text: ...Clotho.

units.rawText: Centaureissi reaches out to Clotho.
units.displayText: Centaureissi reaches out to Clotho.

spans.text: Centaureissi reaches out to Clotho.

units.rawText: Clotho thinks of that despondent soldier, and she unconsciously grabs Centaureissi's hand. However, Centaureissi does not let her do so. Instead, she points to her damaged belly.
units.displayText: Clotho thinks of that despondent soldier, and she unconsciously grabs Centaureissi's hand. However, Centaureissi does not let her do so. Instead, she points to her damaged belly.

spans.text: Clotho thinks of that despondent soldier, and she unconsciously grabs Centaureissi's hand. However, Centaureissi does not let her do so. Instead, she points to her damaged belly.

units.rawText: Their patrols might end up sweeping... this place.
units.displayText: Their patrols might end up sweeping... this place.

spans.text: Their patrols might end up sweeping... this place.

units.rawText: Don't... Don't say any more...
units.displayText: Don't... Don't say any more...

spans.text: Don't... Don't say any more...

units.rawText: Take my battery... It will help you... leave.
units.displayText: Take my battery... It will help you... leave.

spans.text: Take my battery... It will help you... leave.

units.rawText: Go, Clotho... Don't... bury yourself...
units.displayText: Go, Clotho... Don't... bury yourself...

spans.text: Go, Clotho... Don't... bury yourself...

units.rawText: Centaureissi ceases to function.
units.displayText: Centaureissi ceases to function.

spans.text: Centaureissi ceases to function.

units.rawText: ...So... You knew everything from the start?
units.displayText: ...So... You knew everything from the start?

spans.text: ...So... You knew everything from the start?

units.rawText: You knew that I was seeking death and my destruction... If you knew, then why did you still...
units.displayText: You knew that I was seeking death and my destruction... If you knew, then why did you still...

spans.text: You knew that I was seeking death and my destruction... If you knew, then why did you still...

units.rawText: Her only answer is silence.
units.displayText: Her only answer is silence.

spans.text: Her only answer is silence.

units.rawText: In the end, I'm the only one who survived... Is burying others the only thing I can do?
units.displayText: In the end, I'm the only one who survived... Is burying others the only thing I can do?

spans.text: In the end, I'm the only one who survived... Is burying others the only thing I can do?

units.rawText: The distant cannon fire still booms in the distance. Clotho rubs her cheek, as though to wipe away her tears.
units.displayText: The distant cannon fire still booms in the distance. Clotho rubs her cheek, as though to wipe away her tears.

spans.text: The distant cannon fire still booms in the distance. Clotho rubs her cheek, as though to wipe away her tears.

units.rawText: Machine oil streaked in ash smears across the back of her hand. She takes a deep breath and exhales the heat accumulated within her body.
units.displayText: Machine oil streaked in ash smears across the back of her hand. She takes a deep breath and exhales the heat accumulated within her body.

spans.text: Machine oil streaked in ash smears across the back of her hand. She takes a deep breath and exhales the heat accumulated within her body.

units.rawText: No... That's not it. Right now, there's still something I can do.
units.displayText: No... That's not it. Right now, there's still something I can do.

spans.text: No... That's not it. Right now, there's still something I can do.

units.rawText: She ties Hel to her back and scoops up Centaureissi.
units.displayText: She ties Hel to her back and scoops up Centaureissi.

spans.text: She ties Hel to her back and scoops up Centaureissi.

units.rawText: This body is no heavier than the other corpses she has carried, yet Clotho feels an incredible weight in her hands.
units.displayText: This body is no heavier than the other corpses she has carried, yet Clotho feels an incredible weight in her hands.

spans.text: This body is no heavier than the other corpses she has carried, yet Clotho feels an incredible weight in her hands.

units.rawText: It represents hope, a period of warmth in her life, someone who lived more vibrantly than any lost soul who kept a Doll who wanted to "die" firmly anchored to the mortal world.
units.displayText: It represents hope, a period of warmth in her life, someone who lived more vibrantly than any lost soul who kept a Doll who wanted to "die" firmly anchored to the mortal world.

spans.text: It represents hope, a period of warmth in her life, someone who lived more vibrantly than any lost soul who kept a Doll who wanted to "die" firmly anchored to the mortal world.

units.rawText: Live on...
units.displayText: Live on...

spans.text: Live on...

units.rawText: Clotho gently rests her cheeks on Centaureissi's brow as she is held with a careful, tender reverence, before turning her head up and into the distance, a steady look in her eyes.
units.displayText: Clotho gently rests her cheeks on Centaureissi's brow as she is held with a careful, tender reverence, before turning her head up and into the distance, a steady look in her eyes.

spans.text: Clotho gently rests her cheeks on Centaureissi's brow as she is held with a careful, tender reverence, before turning her head up and into the distance, a steady look in her eyes.

units.rawText: I promise to do that... But in return, you also have to promise me that <color=orange>you will "live".</color>
units.displayText: I promise to do that... But in return, you also have to promise me that you will "live".

spans.text: I promise to do that... But in return, you also have to promise me that
you will "live".

units.rawText: The undertaker carries another Doll who has already ceased to function, walking out of this battlefield of death and destruction one step at a time.
units.displayText: The undertaker carries another Doll who has already ceased to function, walking out of this battlefield of death and destruction one step at a time.

spans.text: The undertaker carries another Doll who has already ceased to function, walking out of this battlefield of death and destruction one step at a time.
